news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹3.01 (vs ₹2.06 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹3.01 (up from ₹2.06 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹219.9m (up 361% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹82.2m (up 235% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 37% (down from 52% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 21% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 17% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.2% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks High level of non-cash earnings (42% accrual ratio).
